MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.impact: The material search is no longer only TEXTUAL_MENDES_PHALLUS_PLUS_BACKBONE versus MATERIAL_CG53469. A material phallus-sheath + djed co-assemblage exists in the same protected burial layer.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Vernier's indexed CG 53465-53475 sequence identifies the phallus sheath and neighboring bands/deity sheets, but no item in that inspected sequence is separately catalogued as a djed. CG 53475 is explicitly monkey/falcon, not djed.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.impact: Do not invent a CG/JE number for Quibell's djed. The djed may be embedded in grouped mummy-decoration/deity/debris material, have another catalogue number, or be among material affected by the 1902 provenance fracture.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Quibell localizes the gold objects to the body below the slab but does not give the exact centimeter-scale or anatomical position of the djed relative to the phallus sheath.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.impact: Treat the convergence as a high-value material gate, not as proof that CG53469 is the original member of Osiris.
